responsibility: Provides the generic ELF configuration fragment for targets that use .init_array/.fini_array instead of legacy .init/.fini constructor mechanisms. When HAVE_INITFINI_ARRAY_SUPPORT is enabled, it defines USE_INITFINI_ARRAY, clears legacy section asm ops, and redirects TARGET_ASM_CONSTRUCTOR and TARGET_ASM_DESTRUCTOR to the default ELF init-array/fini-array emitters. This header is a reusable policy switch for constructor/destructor emission.
